taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-27, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 778.8 | 7.70 | 7.70
2 | 383.0 | 6.79 | 14.49
3 | 335.8 | 7.76 | 22.25
4 | 620.2 | 37.49 | 59.74
5 | 5481.2 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as KHA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-27, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station T-27**

Station T-27 comprises a five-layer geoelectric section:
- **Layer 1:** 778.8 $\Omega\cdot$m, thickness 7.70 m (depth: 0.00–7.70 m)
- **Layer 2:** 383.0 $\Omega\cdot$m, thickness 6.79 m (depth: 7.70–14.49 m)
- **Layer 3:** 335.8 $\Omega\cdot$m, thickness 7.76 m (depth: 14.49–22.25 m)
- **Layer 4:** 620.2 $\Omega\cdot$m, thickness 37.49 m (depth: 22.25–59.74 m)
- **Layer 5:** 5481.2 $\Omega\cdot$m (resistive basement)

**Curve Type Evaluation:**
Evaluating successive triplets yields:
1. Layers 1–2–3: $\rho_1 > \rho_2 > \rho_3 \rightarrow$ **Q**
2. Layers 2–3–4: $\rho_2 > \rho_3 < \rho_4 \rightarrow$ **H**
3. Layers 3–4–5: $\rho_3 < \rho_4 < \rho_5 \rightarrow$ **A**

The correct curve type is **QHA**. The on-file classification of **KHA** is incorrect, as layers 1–3 exhibit a continuous decrease in resistivity rather than an intermediate peak.

{"curve_type_stated": "KHA", "label_issue_flagged": true}
